name: session-cost
description: A pane listing every model request of the session with its tokens and cost, beside the session totals and history

autoOpen.title: Open pane at start
autoOpen.description: Open the Session cost pane by itself when a session starts

statusLine.title: Cost status line
statusLine.description: Show the session cost, request count and tokens under the prompt

band.title: Cost chip above the prompt
band.description: Show a one-line cost chip above the prompt; its button carries the keyboard toggle

toggleAction.title: Toggle key action
toggleAction.description: The engine keybinding action whose chord toggles the pane; bind a chord to it in ~/.claude/keybindings.json

historyDays.title: History days
historyDays.description: How many days of per-session, per-day totals to keep for the History and Days views
